entries.text: You received [VAR 0x0204(0001,002C)] BP from Synclaire!
entries.label: s2_sub_041_system_01

entries.text: Ahhh, the euphoria of synchronization![VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_01

entries.text: ...Oh! Hello there.\c\nMy name is Synclaire. I’m quite the outstanding\nresearcher, you know![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_02

entries.text: Would you like to help me out by participating in\nan amazing experiment I’m working on?[VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_03

entries.text: No?! But you’d bear witness to the greatest\ndiscovery of the century![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_04

entries.text: [EMPTY 31]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_05

entries.text: That’s the spirit! Let’s head over to the test area,\nthen![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_add_01

entries.text: You’ll need to have a Pokémon out of its ball for\nthis experiment.[VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_add_02

entries.text: Just let me know once you’re ready![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_add_03

entries.text: Are you ready to help me out with this amazing\nexperiment?[VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_add_04

entries.text: That’s the spirit! Let’s get this started, then...\c\nSynchroooooo...nize![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_06

entries.text: Your mind and feelings are now synchronized\nwith those of your Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_07

entries.text: Now that you’re all synced up, your Pokémon will\nmove as directed by your thoughts![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_08

entries.text: Let’s start with a movement test. There’s a tree\nin front of your Pokémon—try moving over there![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_09

entries.text: Ahhh, yes! You’re so in sync![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_10

entries.text: I was able to get some very useful data from that\nsession. Thank you so much!\c\nHere’s a little something for your trouble.[VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_11

entries.text: You really have a talent for this! Would you mind\nsticking around for just one more experiment?[VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_12

entries.text: It’d be a bit more work than the last one, but I’ll\ngive you something REALLY nice afterward![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_13

entries.text: Are you in the mood to help me out with my\namazing experiment?[VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_14

entries.text: No?! But you’d be a pioneer participating in the\nmost incredible discovery of the century![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_15

entries.text: OK then, here we go! Synchroooooo...nize![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_16

entries.text: Your mind and feelings are synchronized with\nthose of your Pokémon once again![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_17

entries.text: Since this is your second time synchronizing, you\nshould be able to do all sorts of things![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_18

entries.text: So let’s begin the battle test! Try taking on some\nof the other Pokémon in the area![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_19

entries.text: Ahhh, yes! You’ve got the best synchronization\nI’ve ever seen![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_20

entries.text: I’m sure someone with your talent could put this\namazing invention to good use![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_21

entries.text: It’s still a prototype, so its design may look a\nlittle...uninspiring.[VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_22

entries.text: But you can use it to synchronize whenever you\nwant! Try it out with lots of different Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_23

entries.text:
All right, we’ll pause the experiment for now...
Come back when you want to sync up again!\c
Hmm... Could this perhaps have put too much
strain on h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]iser brain...?[VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_24

entries.text:
Have you been using that Synchro Machine I
gave you?\c
You can sync with your Pokémon by pressing the
machine’s L and R Buttons at the same time![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_25

entries.text:
Thank you for being such a keen synchronizer!
I’m putting the data you gathered to great use.\c
Here, let me send you some BP for all your
contributions to science![VAR 0x0114(004E)]
entries.label: s2_sub_041_synchro_26
